anomalies.observed: R36 has schematic value 24k but its MPN FRC0805J240TSD and description specify a 24Ω resistor. The SPICE deck also models R36 as 24k.
anomalies.expected: A 24kΩ (approximately 24.9kΩ) PoE detection/signature resistor across VOUTP/VOUTN, matching the 24k schematic value.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R36") (value "24k") ... (description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS") ... (field (name "MPN") "FRC0805J240TSD")

anomalies.impact: If built per the MPN/BOM, R36 is a 24Ω near-short across the PoE input instead of the required ~25k signature resistance, so PoE detection fails and excessive current may flow.

anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only the common anode pins of D4, D14 and D23. It has no supply, driver, connector or other component on it.
anomalies.expected: These LED common anodes must connect to a 3.3V LED power source, such as +3V3 or a switched LED power rail, so the status LEDs can illuminate.
anomalies.impact: D4, D14 and D23 are left unpowered and will never light; the board loses the corresponding Ethernet and activity status indications.

anomalies.observed: U16 is specified as a common-cathode CC56-12SEKWA display, but its footprint is Display_7Segment:CA56-12SEKWA and its MPN is FJ5461AH, a common-anode 4-digit display.
anomalies.expected: A common-cathode CC56-12SEKWA display (or a footprint/MPN that matches the common-cathode symbol and U17 grid-driving polarity).

anomalies.impact: With a common-anode part installed, the segment/grid polarity is reversed relative to the common-cathode symbol and ET6226M driving, so the 4-digit display will not show the intended digits.

parsed.summary: The design contains several concrete deviations: R36 is specified as 24k but sourced as a 24Ω part in a PoE signature position, the D4/D14/D23 LED anodes are on a floating net with no supply, and U16 is a common-cathode circuit populated with a common-anode display part. These would respectively break PoE detection, disable status LEDs, and prevent the 7-segment display from working.
